Scrollbar

Draw a scrollbar in the rightmost column; text wraps one column narrower while it shows. Measuring the text costs a pass over it per frame. Clicks map to a Tuinet.Widgets.Paragraph.Scroll with Tuinet.Widgets.Scrollbar.PositionAt(Tuinet.Rect,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Int32,Tuinet.Direction) over that column.
